notes: This is a fresh re-measurement of test_app_v7_to_v8_org_v6_r4 with today's exact harness (same ab flags, same microbench scripts/iteration counts, sequential not concurrent execution), superseding the earlier r4.json from the Ruby-3-vs-4 comparison (which used a different, concurrent methodology against r3 and didn't record its ab concurrency setting). Numbers here are NOT directly comparable to that older r4.json.

Fixed the same database.yml naming bug this app had from creation: config/database.yml still pointed at test_app_v6_{development,test,production} (copy-pasted, never renamed) rather than its own database, meaning this app's dev/test DB was, until this run, literally the same live database as test_app_v6's. Renamed to test_app_v7_to_v8_org_v6_r4_* and re-created/migrated/seeded fresh; re-ran the full RSpec suite afterward (34 examples, 0 failures) to confirm no drift.

ar_validation microbench required a script change: `bin/rails runner` is Bundler-scoped, and unlike test_app_v7_to_v8_org_v6_r3 (Ruby 3.3.12, where 'benchmark' is still an ordinary default gem) or test_app_v6_r4 (where 'benchmark' was added to the Gemfile as part of porting Rails 6.1 to Ruby 4.0.7), this app's Gemfile never declares 'benchmark' -- so `require "benchmark"` raised LoadError here specifically (Ruby 4.0.0 dropped it from default gems). Rewrote the shared ar_validation_bench.rb script to call `Process.clock_gettime(Process::CLOCK_MONOTONIC)` directly instead of `Benchmark.realtime` (which is exactly that call under the hood) -- functionally identical measurement, no gem dependency, now used unmodified for all four cells of the matrix. The three earlier cells' AR-validation numbers (measured via Benchmark.realtime) are not re-run since the timing method is identical in substance.

HTTP load test: ab -n 500 -c 10 against /bicycles and /bicycles/1, RAILS_ENV=production with precompiled assets (import maps + Sprockets CSS), DATABASE_URL override (its own database.yml production role/password never provisioned locally, same pattern as the other three apps). 0 failed requests on both endpoints. Run sequentially, alone on the machine (no other app's server running).
boot_time_seconds/boot_rss_mb measured via `/usr/bin/time -l bin/rails runner "exit"` in RAILS_ENV=production, 5 samples.
test_suite duration is bundle exec rspec's own reported 'Finished in' wall time (test env, includes SimpleCov instrumentation like test_app_v7_to_v8_org_v6_r3), 3 samples.
puma_rss_after_load_mb is RSS (ps aux, RSS column) of the single Puma worker process immediately after both ab runs completed.
